reason: My client stuff already lives in Bonsai and my hours in Toggl, and that's where the money actually comes from. This doesn't do time or invoices, so it wouldn't replace anything I pay for. It would just be one more app on top.
objection: No time tracking or invoicing, so I'd still need Toggl and my invoicing tool. Moving my email and calendar into a new app is a big switch for something that still leaves my billing in another place.
would_change_my_mind: If it tracked time against a client and turned those hours into an invoice at the end of the month, so I could cancel Bonsai and Toggl.
